verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference is an inference API. Saved automations with versioning and rollback are a plausible feature for an AI platform, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack shows no automation object that can be versioned, reviewed or rolled back. Nearby features do not count toward this story: API version pinning via header, deprecation logs, fine-tuned model version tracking on dedicated endpoints, and console prompt iteration in the Playground.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
